issuer: the Municipality of Asunción (its Dirección de Tránsito y Transporte)
note: Read 2026-10-30. Paraguay's driving licences are issued by each municipality to those domiciled there (Asunción's regulation: 'deberán contar con la respectiva licencia expedida por la Municipalidad de Asunción'), so Paraguay is kept by its regions; this is the capital district's. The Municipality's General Traffic Regulation, Ordinance 92/23 (the Junta Municipal's ordinance of 2023 amending and extending Ordinance 29/22 to agree with Law 5016/14 and its decree 1417/2015), as the Municipality publishes it (a scan with its own text layer, quoted as that layer reads): the Particular category (cars, jeeps, vans of personal use to 2,000 kg) from 18 (art. 22(a)); a licence is valid 5 years and renewable for the same term (art. 30(a)); holders over 65 prove their fitness every year (art. 30(d)), which the form doesn't hold. A foreigner with temporary residence gets the Extranjero category, also from 18 (art. 24). Fee null: the licence's charge and its yearly revalidation tax (art. 13(d)) are set in the Municipality's tax ordinance, which wasn't read, and Asunción's fines are counted in minimum daily wages (jornales), a unit the game doesn't hold. No identity card is held, and no exchange list (a foreign licence is valid for 90 days to a tourist, art. 31).

sources.title: Municipalidad de Asunción, Ordenanza N° 92/23, Reglamento General de Tránsito
sources.said: REGLAMENTO GENERAL DE TRÁNSITO ... Las personas domiciliadas en Asunción, que deseen conducir cualquier tipo de vehículo, deberán contar con la respectiva licencia expedida por la Municipalidad de Asunción. ... La Licencia de Conducir Categoría Particular habilita a su titular a conducir: jeep, ... a) Haber cumplido 18 años de edad. ... a. La licencia de conducir tendrá una vigencia de 5 (cinco) años y podrá ser renovada por ... un término igual, previa solicitud a la autoridad municipal
